capabilities: Convert vault PDFs to Markdown via Obsidian's built-in PDF parser
Extract content from web links found in bookmark files
Generate topic notes and an index using LDA over pattern-matched files
Create bibliography notes from Zotero exports
extras: Warns the plugin is highly experimental and can have unintended consequences on existing vaults, recommending test vaults. The Make Bibliography section is marked 'TBD'.
problem: Researchers with large collections of PDFs and web links cannot organise or discover common topics across them using folders or tags alone.

relations.evidence: a much more expanded version of this functionality is available in BibNotes
They have a Zotero database, with Zotfile and Better BibTex plugins installed.
a valid Zotero export (in Better BibTex JSON format) file location is specified here

summary: Research tool that converts PDFs and web bookmarks to Markdown, imports Zotero metadata, and generates LDA topic notes linking related documents.
